content.short: OpenTrade is an institutional-grade RWA platform bringing US Treasury yields and private credit on-chain.
content.description:
OpenTrade is a leading decentralized finance protocol designed to bridge the gap between traditional financial markets and the digital economy by tokenizing high-quality real-world assets (RWAs). Built on the Perimeter Protocol developed by Circle Research, the platform allows participants to earn secure yields from institutional-grade assets such as US Treasuries and investment-grade commercial paper. Through its "Yield-as-a-Service" model, OpenTrade provides a transparent and non-custodial framework for both retail and institutional liquidity.

Operating across major networks including Ethereum and Polygon, OpenTrade utilizes the ERC-4626 vault standard to ensure maximum composability within the DeFi ecosystem. The protocol focuses on professional-grade compliance and risk management, partnering with top-tier custodians to secure underlying assets. By providing a robust and scalable solution for on-chain private credit, OpenTrade is empowering participants to build more stable and diversified decentralized portfolios with real-world financial backing.
